# has criterion

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](gmeow-hasCriterion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCriterion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a rubric to one of its evaluative axes (⊑ [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md) — criteria are parts of the framework). NOT functional: rubrics are multi-axis by design.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Rubric`](../classes/gmeow-Rubric.md) -> [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](gmeow-hasCriterion.md) from [`gmeow:Rubric`](../classes/gmeow-Rubric.md) to [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md), [`gmeow:Rubric`](../classes/gmeow-Rubric.md), [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach an evaluative axis to a rubric — rubrics are multi-axis by design.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single criterion (it is non-functional) and avoid generic [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md) when the part is a rubric criterion — this specialization carries the rubric semantics.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](gmeow-hasCriterion.md) from the rubric to each [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md); it specializes [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md), so generic part queries find the criteria.

### Examples

- ex:voiceRubric [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](gmeow-hasCriterion.md) ex:agency, ex:groundedness.
